title: add-interactive-probe-rehearsal-mode-and-nonblocking-fallbacks
author: Priya Shah
description: Context: On-call engineers regularly rehearse mitigation steps against historical incidents, but the current tooling either makes real changes or requires heavy sandbox setup. This PR introduces an 'interactive rehearsal' mode for probes and a non-blocking fallback pathway so responders can safely run diagnostics and rehearsals against historical snapshots or live telemetry without escalating or mutating production state. Motivation: reduce friction for runbook drills, shorten time-to-reproduce for flakier alerts, and give on-call a safe, auditable way to trial probes. What this PR does: 1) Adds a rehearsal runner that executes probes in dry-run mode using telemetry snapshots (supporting JSONL snapshots and rolling windows). 2) Implements a non-blocking fallback layer so probes may return structured recommendations instead of executing side-effecting actions. 3) Adds guardrails and cost caps to prevent expensive probes from running in rehearsal by accident. 4) Adds a lightweight UI toggle and CLI flag (--rehearsal-snapshot=ID, --no-side-effects) for invoking rehearsal mode. 5) Adds replay timers and deterministic seeding so probe timings match historical context. Checklist: - [x] design doc (linked in Linear ENG-1023) - [x] unit + integration tests for runner and fallback behavior - [x] end-to-end rehearsal smoke test using recorded snapshots - [x] doc snippets for on-call quickstart - [x] safety review and feature flag gating Rolling out: feature is gated behind incident.rehearsal.enabled cluster feature flag and opt-in per-team policy. Operators can configure cost caps in helm values. Testing notes: integration suite initially exposed a concurrency race in the probe cache; added a mutex and deterministic test fixtures. To exercise locally: ./bin/incident-bot run-probe --name network-conn --rehearsal-snapshot=2026-01-07-02 --no-side-effects Results are returned in a structured JSON report with recommended runbook steps and a confidence score. Backwards compatibility: probes default to live behavior unless rehearsal flags or snapshots are supplied. Related work: builds on the snapshot format introduced in SLO-PR 12899 and incident-bot snapshot exporter (ENG-980).

release_notes:
- Introduces interactive rehearsal mode for probes: run diagnostics against snapshots without side effects.
- Adds non-blocking fallbacks that return structured recommendations instead of executing changes.
- Feature gated behind incident.rehearsal.enabled and per-team opt-in; safe helm defaults prevent accidental costs.
notes_for_oncall: Use --rehearsal-snapshot=<ID> to replay historical telemetry. Rehearsal returns a structured RunResult with fields: summary, recommendations[], confidence, simulated_timeline. Do not run expensive remediation probes without consulting cost caps in helm values. The UI provides a Rehearsal toggle to try runbooks during drills.
risk_assessment: low: rehearsal is gated and opt-in; non-blocking fallback prevents side-effecting actions. Added cost caps and a safety review. Concurrency fix reduces likelihood of flakiness in parallel rehearsals.
